message.content: Rob Bonta serves as California's Attorney General. His office dismissed felony vandalism and conspiracy charges against five pro-Palestinian Stanford protesters on September 21, 2026, reducing the case to one hundred hours of community service and roughly fifty-two thousand dollars in restitution. He has not called the war in Gaza a genocide or publicly opposed U.S. military or economic aid to Israel. On endorsements that map to those two tests, Bonta carries backing from CAIR Action, Vote for Peace, and Representative Ro Khanna, while the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club also endorses him. Michael E. Gates, the Republican opponent, co-authored a 2025 Justice Department letter opening a civil-rights investigation into the University of California over alleged discrimination against Jewish or Israeli employees, and his campaign is endorsed by the Israeli-American Civic Action Network, the Iranian-American Republican Council, and Americans4Hus. Bonta's demonstrated willingness to de-escalate prosecution of pro-Palestinian students, paired with pro-Palestine-aligned organizational support, sets him apart in this statewide contest.
